big_picture.title: Nasdaq Turns Negative For 2026 As Anthropic Plunges; Trump Backs Lutnick, Inflation Data Due
big_picture.excerpt: The Nasdaq composite sank Friday with AI stocks mauled. President Trump backed Commerce Secretary Lutnick amid Nvidia fallout.
paragraphs: The stock market fell sharply Friday, with the Nasdaq composite turning negative for the year, as technology plays plunged. Meanwhile, President Donald Trump said he still has confidence in under-pressure Commerce Secretary Howard Lutnick despite more Nvidia (NVDA) fallout. New inflation data now looms in the Thanksgiving holiday week.

The Nasdaq was butchered by the bears on Friday as it plunged 5.3%. The tech-heavy index sits deep in correction territory as it is 18% off its recent high — uncomfortably close to bear market levels. It's now 10% below its 200-day moving average and has surrendered all its gains for the year. Instead, it is now down 2.7% in 2026.
